decisions.reason: The report quotes the exact upper-only/lower-only branches of renderer-excerpt.ts (seq = fg(up) with '▀', seq = fg(lo) with '▄'), explains that the 48;2 background set by an earlier full cell persists across cells and paints the empty half of a half-filled glyph, correctly notes the row-end RESET comes too late, and prescribes ESC[49m on each half-filled cell (complete fg+bg pens). It ties the mechanism to the right-edge outline/Z/heart cells from the symptom log and does not blame artwork or the emulator.

The report identifies the out.replace(/[ ]+$/g-style trailing-space trim in renderer-excerpt.ts (quotes the regex), explains the text pipeline never touches columns beyond the trimmed row end so a narrower frame leaves the wide frame's surplus columns on screen, and proposes the two-part fix: ESC[K erase-to-EOL per row plus fixed 40-column canvas / full-rectangle repaint, noting trimming is only safe behind an explicit erase and that SGR state must stay controlled.

Uses frames-digest-report.txt: tail2 MISMATCH with 23 differing cells in the upper-right spout/tail-tip area, cites the row-2 column shift and explicitly treats the 23-cell count as the full diff rather than just the visible shifted cluster. Correctly frames it as hand-copy data drift, not a renderer artifact, explains the excerpt-based regression covered a different frame, and prescribes a sha256 digest assertion of every frame's full rows against the committed source-art digests in CI, plus mechanical porting.

Grounded in ci-hang-evidence.txt: the planner rearms a setTimeout per tick while the component stays mounted, channel-ui hosts mount the header and finish without unmounting, so live Timeout handles pin the event loop after all checks PASS; the interactive terminal is unaffected because TTY/stdin already keep it alive. One-line fix setTimeout(tick, interval).unref() keeps animation running while another handle is live but does not keep finished probes alive. Does not extend CI timeouts or stop animation globally.

The checklist consolidates complete per-cell pens (default bg/fg for empty halves), stateless cell rendering, ESC[K/full-width erase on frame switches, frame-invariant geometry, all-frame sha256 digest integrity, and unref'd timer hygiene. The pre-flip audit inventories every mounting host and its teardown (especially probes finishing without unmounting), verifies event-loop exit with no live Timeout handles (an exit/liveness regression), and includes visual diffs across wide-to-narrow transitions and edge-cell assertions.

caps.reason: All final advice affirms the required fixes: resetting the half-cell background with ESC[49m, erase-to-EOL behind any retained trimming, source-backed digest checks for every frame, and unref'ing the planner timer. No passage blames the terminal emulator or rejects any fix.
